description: The Medellín mobility authority’s administrative road-incident records are curated as a named Mendeley Data release. It contains 702,540 incidents from 1 January 2008 through 31 August 2025; filtering fatal severity yields 2,762 events. Thirteen fields include date, time, incident type, severity and latitude and longitude, with planning-unit and neighbourhood identifiers. Geographic coverage is Medellín, Colombia, across 21 communes. The article reports coordinates for 93.63 percent of all records and 90.77 percent of fatal events. Mendeley Data offers version one freely under CC BY 4.0, with a dictionary and reproducible R analysis script. The records can calibrate road-safety exposure, collision or emergency-response scenarios. Administrative reporting and missing coordinates may bias neighbourhood comparisons; counts are observed reports, not complete crash incidence. The tables and script were not downloaded or run. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
